Issue for Consideration Matter pertains to the issue that if the amendment to s.80DD of the Income Tax Act, 1961 can be given retrospective effect. Headnotes† Income Tax Act, 1961 – s.80DD (as amended) – Deduction in respect of maintenance including medical treatment of a – As per amendment to s.80DD, on attaining the age of 60 years or more by an individual subscriber or a member of an HUF, the payment or deposit to the scheme envisaged u/s.80DD can be discontinued and the monetary benefit which would have accumulated can be made use of –
